channel.title: Kieran J. O'Leary — Journal
channel.description: US patent attorney and IP strategist in Munich. Writing about patent prosecution, preissuance submissions, and the software I build along the way.

item.title: The Duty of Disclosure Doesn't Translate
item.description: Practicing US patent law from Munich means translating between legal systems, not just languages. Nothing produces more disbelief across the table than explaining the American duty of candor to a European client.

item.title: Why Pulverhorn Keeps Three Copies of Every Submission
item.description: The most important design decision in the filing platform I'm building isn't visible in the interface. It's a data model shaped by a question no engineer would think to ask — "what will I need to prove in five years?"

item.title: Building 3PPS.info
item.description: Why I built a plain-English guide to the USPTO's Third-Party Preissuance Submission process, and what I learned trying to explain a legal procedure to people who don't want to become lawyers.
